'''Melody Lake''' was a deep body of [[Water/Legends|water]] located on the slopes of [[Sistra Mountain]] on [[Yavin 8/Legends|Yavin 8]] and was the ancestral home of the [[Melodie]] [[Species/Legends|race]].
